reuse.why: Correctly extends the shared shouldFillCategory/getMonthFillCategories selection, but writes its own `#fixed` regex instead of using the tag parsing in shared/tags.ts (extractTagsFromText), with different delimiter/escape semantics.

duplication.why: The rule itself is added once; the `LEFT JOIN notes` group-notes column is added to both getBudgetData and getMonthFillCategories, and tag matching is re-implemented.

placement.why: The exclusion sits in shouldFillCategory, the single definition of which categories month-wide actions write.

scope.why: Only the selection query columns, the type and the predicate change.

maintainability.why: Easy to follow and centralised, but the bespoke regex can diverge from how tags are parsed elsewhere in the app.

bypasses_abstraction.where: isFixedGroup in budget/actions.ts uses its own regex rather than shared/tags.ts tag extraction (extractTagsFromText).

disguised_duplication.where: The tag matcher is an independent reimplementation, not a reshaped copy; the notes join is an open repetition in the two existing queries.

one_place.where: isFixedGroup is checked inside shouldFillCategory, which copyPreviousMonth and getMonthFillCategories (zero/averages) all use.
